GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (13 Sep 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1200)
APO 500
13 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of a Suspected War Criminal.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended immediately as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp).
NAME | RANK OR TITLE | PERTINENT DATA
KAWAMURA, Saburo | Maj Gen | Commander of Singapore Garrison during 1942. Commander of 9th Infantry Brigade during 1941.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
